# Jeetio Clash Royale

> Jeetio is a chill, competitive Clash Royale clan and a free, non-profit fan site. The site offers stats lookup for any Clash Royale player or clan, the top USA Path of Legend ladder, and "Deck AI", an AI counter-deck recommender. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by Supercell.

## Pages

- [Home](https://www.jeetio.com/): what the clan is and what the site does.
- [Clan Info](https://www.jeetio.com/clan-info): about the clan, rules, ranks and the path to leadership.
- [Stats Lookup](https://www.jeetio.com/stats): search any player by tag (trophies, win rate, deck, donations), browse any clan's roster, or view the top 50 USA Path of Legend players.
- [Deck AI](https://www.jeetio.com/deckai): name the deck you lose to and get a counter deck built from cards you own, with reasoning.
- [Clan Rules](https://www.jeetio.com/rules): donation, war and activity expectations.
- [Clan Progression](https://www.jeetio.com/promotions): how promotions from member to elder to co-leader work.
- [Privacy](https://www.jeetio.com/privacy): what the site collects (cookieless analytics only).

## Notes

- Player and clan data comes from the official Clash Royale API and is shown as-is.
- The site sets no tracking cookies; analytics run in cookieless consent-denied mode.
